title: euphrasia collina subsp. gunnii
intro: Euphrasia collina subsp. gunnii, commonly known as the Tasmanian eye-bright, is a plant species belonging to the family Orobanchaceae. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe eye irritations and promote overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Euphrasia collina subsp. gunnii include its ability to act as a protective agent for the eyes and mucous membranes, while its bioactive constituents, such as iridoid glycosides and flavonoids, contribute to its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Euphrasia collina subsp. gunnii for medicinal purposes.
